notes.title: v1.2 Summer Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Your Review Matters![/h1][p]Hey everyone, if you’ve played President 47, we’d really appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave us a review here on Steam. Reviews help a ton by giving us valuable feedback to keep improving. Thanks so much for your support!  [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Update Notes[/h2][p]We’ve been hard at work making improvements to President 47, and here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][p] [/p][h3]Language Support[/h3][p]The game is now translated into multiple languages so more players around the world can join the fight for freedom!
 [/p][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][p]Minor polish and quality-of-life updates across the board. [/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
